conflicts.permit: These partners may access your data and operate under their own privacy policies.
conflicts.prohibit: These partners process your data only at and according to our instructions to provide the Service, such as hosting, player support, advertising, analytics and fraud prevention.
conflicts.situation: When partners provide advertising or analytics services and process user data.
conflicts.reason: One clause restricts partners to processing data strictly under GlobalFun's instructions, while another permits advertising and analytics partners to access data under their own independent policies.
